journey.name: savings select funds
journey.description:
Verifies that Transfer to Savings lets the user pick what moves: each open channel and Spark are rows on the Select funds list, all selected by default, and the confirm screen shows only what is selected, with Spark's withdrawal fee only while Spark is selected. With a single item (Spark alone, or one channel without a Spark balance) the confirm screen shows no Advanced button and moves everything, as before Spark.
Precondition: onboarded Debug build with a Spark balance and at least one open channel. On iOS the two live on different regtest chains: open the channels through Manual Setup to Blocktank's staging regtest node, funded from Savings, and fund Spark from Lightspark's web regtest faucet (https://app.lightspark.com/regtest-faucet) to the address on Settings › Advanced › Lightning Connections › Spark; Spark adds it to Spending within a few minutes. Start on the wallet home screen. The journey stops before the swipe. Spark prices its fee on the confirm screen, so allow about 20 seconds for "Spark fee" to show.
Adapted from Android: a picked selection shows "Transfer all" in place of "Advanced" on both platforms, so reaching the list again takes "Transfer all" first.

actions.action: If the transfer to savings intro appears, tap "Get Started" (testTag "SavingsIntro-button")
Tap "Continue" (testTag "AvailabilityContinue") on the funds availability screen
On the confirm screen, verify the amount is the channels' balance plus the Spark balance, a "Spark fee" amount shows, and an "Advanced" button shows
Verify the "Select funds to transfer" screen lists a "Spark" row with the Spark balance and one "Connection N" row per open channel, every switch on, and "Total selected" equals the confirm amount
Turn off the last "Connection N" row and verify "Total selected" drops by that row's amount
Tap "Continue" and verify the confirm amount equals the new total, "Spark fee" still shows, and the button reads "Transfer all"
Tap "Transfer all", then "Advanced", turn off the "Spark" row and every "Connection N" row, and verify "Continue" is disabled
Turn on the "Spark" row only and tap "Continue"
Verify the confirm amount equals the Spark balance and "Spark fee" shows
Tap "Transfer all" and verify the amount returns to the channels' balance plus the Spark balance, and the button reads "Advanced"
Tap "Advanced", turn off the "Spark" row, tap "Continue", and verify the amount equals the channels' balance with no "Spark fee"
